title: Verify: Frontend config loader unit tests
summary: Add Vitest and unit tests proving loadFrontendConfig defaults and overrides.
description:
Context: ACT-FE added loadFrontendConfig without tests.
Desired behavior: Add Vitest wiring and config.test.ts that asserts defaults and env overrides with plain objects (no browser, no network).
Expected result: Filtered vitest run for config tests passes.
Why: Maps REQ-FE acceptance on config defaults/example keys to unit evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Given empty env object, when loadFrontendConfig runs in the unit test, then apiBaseUrl is http://localhost:8080 and appName is StoryForge.
Given env overrides VITE_API_BASE_URL and VITE_APP_NAME, when loadFrontendConfig runs, then returned fields equal the overrides.
technical_constraints: VERIFY = unit tests only; mock env via plain objects; no Playwright/Cypress

steps.action: Add script test=vitest run and test:config=vitest run config.test.ts; add devDependencies vitest ^2.1.0. Do not change production dependencies.
steps.code: scripts.test -> "vitest run"; scripts["test:config"] -> "vitest run config.test.ts"; devDependencies.vitest -> "^2.1.0"
steps.expected: package.json includes vitest scripts; install succeeds as prerequisite for the test command.

steps.action: Create vitest.config.ts using vitest/config defineConfig with test.environment node and include **/*.test.ts.
steps.expected: Vitest loads this config when running config tests.

steps.action: Create tests: (1) loadFrontendConfig({}) expects apiBaseUrl http://localhost:8080 and appName StoryForge; (2) loadFrontendConfig({ VITE_API_BASE_URL: 'http://api.test', VITE_APP_NAME: 'SF-Test' }) expects those override values. Import from ./config.
